desc:
The game is in EARLY BETA stage, expect bugs, incomplete areas and missing features.

LIMINARIUM is an experimental solo project of mine which showcases a seed based algorithm capable of procedurally creating areas similar to Kane Pixels' visual style of the Backrooms, which means that the whole map, and most room layouts are NEVER the same unless you decide to use the same seed. Explore the complex or hide from the entity.

Special credit to Midnight for various 3D assets
